name: David
overview: Scripture presents David as a man of God chosen to lead and shepherd His people, exemplified in his role as a shepherd himself and his declaration that the LORD is his shepherd, ensuring he lacks nothing. He is depicted as a victorious leader who overcomes enemies and rises to prominence, becoming head over nations and serving as anointed king of Israel. His life is also marked by musical devotion to God, as seen in his association with instruments and psalms that express trust and deliverance. These portrayals highlight David's divine selection, leadership, and intimate relationship with God.
